task.title: Implement diagram-backed system KB audits and graph nodes
task.summary: Parse system diagram YAML into first-class graph refs and audit system docs against diagram_refs and requires_doc rules after migration flags are enabled.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki can treat system diagrams as the system ontology and detect orphan docs, missing diagram refs, stale refs, and requires_doc gaps.
acceptance: Diagram YAML parser exposes components, adapters, flows, domain entities, lifecycles, policies, artifacts, actors, and external systems as graph/audit refs.
System docs can declare diagram_refs in frontmatter and audits verify target existence.
Diagram nodes can declare requires_doc and audits report missing owning docs.
Migration mode can warn before hard enforcement so existing repos can adopt gradually.
non_goals: Do not require every diagram node to have a doc.
Do not replace renderer-specific diagram output in this task.
Do not implement default graph lens simplification in this task.
verification: Add tests for valid refs, missing refs, missing requires_doc docs, and migration warning mode.

exit_criteria: All TASK-002 acceptance criteria mapped to code/tests/docs evidence.
Relevant package and CodeWiki checks pass.
Fresh implementation validation required before task close.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Diagram YAML parser exposes components, adapters, flows, domain entities, lifecycles, policies, artifacts, actors, and external systems as graph/audit refs.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/application/knowledge/diagram-parser.ts parses YAML diagram collections and classifies refs; src/application/graph.ts emits system_diagram/system_diagram_ref nodes, diagram flow edges, and views.system_diagrams.by_category. tests/smoke/diagram-refs.test.mjs asserts all required categories exist.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: System docs can declare diagram_refs in frontmatter and audits verify target existence.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: validateSystemDiagramRefs resolves diagram_refs from ParsedDoc frontmatter against primary and alias ref indexes; lint and file-structure audit emit diagram-ref-target-missing when a declared target is absent. Tests cover valid refs and missing targets.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Diagram nodes can declare requires_doc and audits report missing owning docs.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Parser records requires_doc; validation builds docs_by_ref from owning system docs; lint/audit emit diagram-node-missing-required-doc when no system doc declares the required ref. Tests cover missing required docs.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Migration mode can warn before hard enforcement so existing repos can adopt gradually.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: codewiki.system_diagrams.diagram_refs.mode supports off/warn/error; warn mode emits warnings for missing doc refs and requires_doc gaps, error mode emits errors. Tests cover warning and error modes.
